description: "A Frog He Would A-Wooing Go" by Randolph Caldecott is a whimsical children's picture book written during the late 19th century. This delightful book captures the adventures of a frog who is determined to woo a pretty mouse, embarking on a journey that involves charming interactions with various animal friends.
